steps.content:
19:23, February 1, N.F. 114.
Eastside City Council Meeting Hall,
Tide of Ashes Special Operation Meeting.

Inside the hall, you and the representatives of DisCity's council are seated on the west side, facing guests in Outland attire on the opposite side. Dressed in a light, smoky green robe, Du Ruo stands out even among the envoys. She sits across from you on the east side of the venue.
In the center of the meeting room, the Schorl from Paradeisos is reporting yesterday's battle results.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The target, codenamed <color=#fb9259>Sun Crow</color>, invaded from the northwest of WhiteSands and got closer to the DisSea than any other Apostles of Ashes did in nearly three decades. It passed through three mandatory surveillance nets without triggering any alarms, an unprecedented occurrence.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Sun Crow is powerful and particularly intelligent, capable of consciously controlling Mania radiation to create interference and evade detection. It was repelled in the first encounter, but entering the DisSea is its instinct. It will definitely assault the Broken Frontline again.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We know very little about the enemy. While strengthening our defenses and conducting searches, the most important task at this stage is to gather information. To this end, DisCity accepts the support of the Eastian Alliance to locate the Sun Crow and eliminate it once and for all.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: We haven't cooperated with Outland states for a long time, as there has been no necessity. But... given the current special circumstances, we need Eastia's experience, since they are experts in dealing with that monster.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: Please.

A man in white from the Eastian delegation stands up and bows to you formally. His face is hidden behind a bronze mask, but the bizarre Outland patterns on it are enough to draw attention and wariness from those around him.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: The Sun Crow brings drought and devastation, and this is just the beginning. As an envoy of Eastia, I cannot sit back knowing such evil's at play.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: That monster has plagued Eastia for years. We've fought it for decades, gaining expertise along the way. Last year's natural disaster broke its seal, allowing it to escape. Of course, Eastia would hunt it down wherever it may flee.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: We've traveled thousands of miles here, hoping to help you all quell this disaster.
On the other side, Schorl aptly projects images of the Sun Crow being sealed in N.F. 106. This visual evidence is what convinced Paradeisos, you suppose.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: You defeated it seven years ago? How many Hypercubes did it take to deal with an Apostle of Ashes of this magnitude?

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: I'll be frank. After the disaster in N.F. 106 disrupted our trade, Eastia's Hypercube reserves were nearly depleted. We could only rely on our own strength to defeat the Sun Crow.
The hall erupts in murmurs. Representatives of DisCity whisper among themselves, clearly skeptical that there exist other solutions to Mania disasters besides DisCity's unique Hypercubes.

You recall those strange green symbols you saw before passing out yesterday. They are unlike any FAC force fields or Sinner abilities you've seen, but they feel familiar, as if you've seen them somewhere before.

steps.speaker: Ring Researcher Rep
steps.content: We've reviewed yesterday's battle records. Indeed, you used some kind of sorcery to successfully suppress the Sun Crow Apostle. The effect was significant and entirely different from modern Hypercube technology.

steps.speaker: Ring Researcher Rep
steps.content: We've long heard about Eastia's special sorcery for controlling Mania. May I ask if it's a kind of Mania sorcery? Where did it come from, and how was it developed...

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: It's just some sorcery passed down among Eastia's seers that permits minor restrictions on the Sun Crow's actions.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: What truly helped us overcome the calamity and defeat the evil was an ancient myth that has been passed down in Eastia for millennia.
He bows respectfully.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: The Perishing Star falls, calamities descend... Our ancestors had long foretold the era of great disasters and recorded the true method to subdue demons in legends.
There's another stir among the audience. This statement sounds overly absurd, leaving people both incredulous of everything they've heard and eager for further explanation.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: ...The fall of the Perishing Star occurred just over a century ago. Did Eastia foresee the calamity before then? What method could they have suggested to resist the Apostle of Ashes thousands of years ago, back when humanity hadn't even discovered gunpowder?

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Eastia has always been home to gifted individuals, whom we call seers. They are capable of spiritual communication and are the interpreters and scribes of myths. I'll let her take over the introduction.
You look toward Du Ruo. Noticing your gaze, she turns to smile at you, but doesn't begin to speak.
Instead, she turns to the door of the meeting hall. A childlike voice comes through, reciting words that take you by surprise.
The sun deformed, demise befell. Hills burned and charred, lives ebbed and fell...
It's the poem from your dream! You cannot forget that suffocating feeling brought by those inexplicable, ominous words. Just then, the door suddenly opens...
A shape darts past the front row. Obscured by the heads in front, you can't see it clearly. The next second, it leaps onto the podium. It's actually a child?!

It could be because of her bizarre outfit, or the captivating poem. Or perhaps the calm demeanor of the Eastian envoys convinces everyone that this is no accident. No one stops the child, and she straightens her clothes and then bows deeply in greeting.

steps.speaker: Girl in Eastern Attire
steps.content: I am <color=#fb9259>Yanyan</color>, the seer of Sunsink City. Seers communicate with the spirits, decipher scriptures, repel demons, and comfort the masses. What I've just recited is the <color=#fb9259>Ode to Sun</color>, a millennium-old myth from Eastia.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It details the origin of the Sun Crow calamity and the method to eradicate it. Yanyan has committed every detail to memory, specifically…

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ages past, there emerged from the sun a giant bird known as the Sun Crow. It embodied both deity and evil, wielding unrivaled fiery might.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Humans must worship it respectfully, or else, if the Sun Crow got angry, disaster would follow its flight, casting misfortune upon all in its path. In other words…

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content:
Poison uncured, from plants impure. Dragon's frenzy, bane of the sea.
Minds invaded, by foul spirits. Ten suns in sky, lest crops survived.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Came a tough time when harvests were poor and offerings grew meager. Feeling neglected, the Sun Crow was furious and inflicted three great calamities on the populace as punishment. Eventually, ten suns rose in the sky at once, threatening to burn everything down. And then...
She spreads her arms in a gesture of praising the sun.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Brave champion sang, sunward quest began. Crimson bow taut, white fletchings shot.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Amid the people's despair, a hero came. This nameless champion snapped a branch from the sky-reaching blessed tree, took the Dragon's Vein from East Sea, wove an unburnable Wraith Spirit fletching, and ultimately crafted an Almighty Bow capable of piercing the sky from miles away.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Finally, surrounded by the people, and in front of the grand altar...
The girl steps onto the desk of the meeting hall, posing as if drawing a large bow with her hands. She sounds very passionate though she's only holding a small wooden slingshot.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The hero drew the Almighty Bow, aiming at the sky, and brought down the nine suns one by one, leaving only the Sun Crow remaining. In fear and rage, it cawed as it fled, "You short-lived mortal! I shall return when you are dead!"

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The hero laughed back, "Bring it on then! Another hero will rise after me, with another Almighty Bow! The legend has begun. When you return, you'll be no deity, just a hapless bird destined to be shot down! Ha! Ha! Ha!"
The child's high-pitched howl echoes in the silent hall. The girl strikes a final pose, then stands straight to signal the end of the grand play, and gives another deep bow.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: That was a quick summary of the Ode to Sun. Now that we know how to fight the Sun Crow, time to get moving!
The current atmosphere doesn't allow for jokes. The idea of using ancient mythology to combat Mania is unbelievable enough, and this girl's animated performance only adds to the shock.

steps.speaker: Councilor A
steps.content: What does this have to do with eliminating the Apostle of Ashes? And why is a child allowed in such an important meeting?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hey, isn't it clearly stated in the myth? Go snap off a branch from the blessed tree, take the Dragon's Vein from the East Sea, weave a Wraith Spirit fletching, and finally craft an Almighty Bow powerful enough to shoot down the Sun Crow from thousands of miles away!

steps.speaker: Councilor B
steps.content: Stop talking nonsense. What East Sea, Dragon's Vein, blessed tree... Such things don't exist in DisCity.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Myths are profound metaphors. They are puzzles given to us by the gods. It's okay if ordinary people don't understand. Leave the interpretation to those who have a gift for spiritual communication. That's exactly the job of seers in every generation. That's what I do!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yanyan is the current seer for Sunsink City, and I will lead everyone to seek the oracles and follow the myth's instructions to craft the Almighty Bow for the Sun Shot. Once the Almighty Bow is made and the Sun Crow is shot down, everything will come to a perfect conclusion!
She pats her chest confidently, but no one would trust a child's promise. The hall is filled with rising doubts.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: This is a waste of time. I'm heading back to the front line.
Amid the chaos, someone left his seat. It's the FAC operation commander for this Apostle of Ashes campaign.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The Apostle's destination is DisSea. When it got into the 20-kilometer range last time, the resulting Mania resonance already spread to three Black Ring ruins.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I set aside all my tasks to come to this meeting to find a way to combat the Apostle of Ashes, not to listen to some Outland brat's nonsensical babble. Is this what the frontline soldiers sacrificed their lives for?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hold on! Yanyan is serious. I've been working hard on my seer training, and I've already mastered the art. Look!
She spreads her palm and musters enough strength to create a small spark in her hand. It leaps up and twists into a strange rune before it disappears.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: She's a Sinner?!
That's a sorcery, and it's very similar to the Mania flames of the Sun Crow Apostle. You've seen similar symbols on that giant bird.

Before a bigger clamor breaks out, a figure of green and white steps onto the podium, taking Yanyan's hand. The flames are extinguished instantly. Du Ruo shields Yanyan behind her placidly, facing everyone in the audience.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Well, even two neighboring towns in Eastia can have vastly different customs, let alone DisCity which is worlds away. We must communicate in a common language.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I am the scholar of the delegation. My area of expertise is Eastian mythology, and I have also studied some of DisCity's scientific theories. I am aware that the ways we perceive the world differ greatly.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Let me be the "interpreter" here.

Du Ruo raises her hand. You're surprised to see the incense burner she held now float in mid-air, emitting faint green smoke that swirls around her palm. She's openly displaying her abilities as a Sinner in front of everyone.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In Eastia, there are a small number of highly intuitive and talented individuals who can comprehend the unknown and gain the psychic power to become <color=#fb9259>seers</color>.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Here in DisCity, they might be called Sinners and are to be captured and strictly monitored by a certain Chief. But in Eastia, seers are greatly respected, especially as a key force against natural disasters when Hypercubes are scarce.
Du Ruo gives you a smile, but a skeptical voice appears from the audience.

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: We also have experts on Sinners here. Of course we know the potential power of this child and your seers.
He implies something more. Both seers have used their powers, and an analysis of their abilities has already been quickly generated and distributed to every DisCity attendee.
Based on their M-values, one is A-Class, and although the other is S-Class, she has a Catalyst Tendency. They couldn't possibly have the power to confront the Apostle of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Do you really? As early as last August, Yanyan foresaw the Sun Crow's arrival at DisCity. That's why we've crossed the sea to be here. Had we come just a little later...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The Sun Crow would likely have broken through your defenses yesterday...
An undeniable fact. The hall falls back into silence.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Our myths have been passed down for millennia. It's true that some of the ambiguous descriptions must have led to far-fetched interpretations. But there are indeed claims that have been verified.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: When the Sun Crow loses control, disasters follow wherever it goes. <color=#fb9259>Poison uncured from plants impure</color>, <color=#fb9259>bane of the sea</color>, and <color=#fb9259>minds invaded by foul spirits</color> correspond to the three strange phenomena. As the officer just mentioned, the three Black Ring ruins are already showing signs.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: After the Three Calamities, the Sun Crow will strengthen quickly and eventually burn down the entire city. Time is running out, and if we waste more of it on suspecting each other...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Do you wish to witness <color=#fb9259>the ten suns hanging in the sky</color>? And experience the apocalyptic disaster that destroyed our homeland and wreaked havoc across all of Eastia?

steps.speaker: DisCity Representative
steps.content: Are you threatening us?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...Please continue. This kind of practical intelligence is what we need. Please lend us your strength to stop the disaster.
The FAC officer returns to his seat, watching Du Ruo intently. She responds with a smile and a bow, and she resumes her calm and gentle demeanor.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Thank you, officer, but I'm only a non-combat mythologist in our delegation. The main force against the Sun Crow will be the sealers and the seer, who will guide us through the myth. They are the ones who need DisCity's special assistance.
Her gaze moves past the crowd to the silent Schorl in the corner.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Certainly. The Sun Crow has a unique invisibility. Its approach to the DisSea this time already caused no small disturbance within the city, and it will surely follow the Apostle of Ashes' instinct to return to the DisSea. We must not let our guard down.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: In the past year, the city faced many changes that led to huge consumption of resources. The production of Hypercubes has not returned to normal either. The previous high-cost defense methods are no longer suitable for this operation. We need a safer and more efficient plan, hence cooperation with Eastia is necessary.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: From today on, please have the delegation's sealers assist the FAC in fortifying the defenses and locating the Sun Crow. All operations concerning the bow-making or the myth required by the envoys will be fully supported by the MBCC.
Du Ruo turns back to give you a meaningful look.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Of course, I'm relieved to know that Chief will be there. Are you taking us to your residence... Excuse me, um, the Bureau?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: We'll have a lot of important matters to discuss for the upcoming operations.

You look at Du Ruo, but your gaze inadvertently flits to the 9th Agency operative standing silently against the east wall, behind everyone. He's watching the envoys, and upon noticing your gaze, he tips his hat slightly in acknowledgment.
You don't need his reminder to remember the "real instructions" received before the meeting.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not sending me just to help them, are you? You and your boss don't believe in that myth or the so-called envoys. What is my real task?

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: We indeed need their help, but we must also be vigilant of their ulterior motives.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: After all, it's been eight years since we last saw our friends from the Outlands. Those myths and sorceries are beyond logic. If there really is an ulterior motive behind them, especially during this Apostle crisis... It'd be too dangerous.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: So, while assisting them, please also keep an eye out, Chief. I will stay in touch with you.

options: Looks like I can't say no

steps.content: After receiving a positive response, she gives you that evaluating look again with her amiable eyes.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Well, I look forward to our cooperation, Chief...

It's been almost a year, and we've finally caught up with it. The Sun Crow has grown much stronger than before. Here, it's known as the Apostle of Ashes, and the disasters it brings are called the Tide of Ashes. There are probably many of its kind here. But unlike in Eastia before, this time the Sun Crow has a very clear purpose... It wants to enter the DisSea, or rather, BR-000.

I can only get so much information here. But from the first encounter, it's clear that the Apostle of Ashes resonates significantly with the Black Rings. The Apostle's power was noticeably strengthened as it approached the DisSea, and its proximity also caused an obvious resonance in the DisSea and the Black Rings of DisCity. What will happen if it enters the DisSea? DisCity is very wary of this. They've prepared many counter-strategies, and they view the crisis in an entirely different way. Although information is limited... a chance must lie somewhere.
